title: Travel Completed | APPR | Controllable | Delay 3�<6 hrs | Cash (Interac) Selected | Single Pax | 1 Leg | Basic Aeroplan | No Changes
description:
Validates the simplest end-to-end eligible scenario with a Basic Aeroplan member who selects Cash (Interac) over AC Wallet. Single passenger on a single domestic AC leg, delayed 4 hours due to controllable reason (Code 64). Aeroplan Basic profile (9876543210) is linked to the booking � system offers BOTH Cash ($400 CAD) and AC Wallet ($480 CAD with 20% top-up). Customer selects Cash/Interac payout at $400 CAD. Confirms DDS correctly identifies APPR regime, controllable classification, Tier 1 delay band, and generates EL-01 response code. Also validates CyberSource GREEN passes through to auto-approved payment. Validates that AC Wallet is correctly offered but not forced � customer free choice of Cash is respected.
Prerequisites:
PNR: TC001 � single passenger Catherine Bouchard (Adult - Basic Aeroplan Member). Journey: 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ. Scheduled arrival: 14:00. Actual arrival: 18:00 (4hr delay). Arrival delay code: 64 (Flight Crew Shortage � Controllable). Flight status: Arrived (operated). Booking changes: None � no VOL or INVOL. Carrier: AC only. 72hrs: Elapsed (filed D+13). Time limit: Within 366 days. No duplicate case. Not employee, not infant. Aeroplan: Linked (9876543210), Basic Member in good standing. CyberSource: Configured to return GREEN. RDS: No flags.
